facts.fact: Lucan 昨夜蜷在沙发上过夜。
facts.anchor: The sofa is far too short for me to lie across

facts.fact: Micah 醒来仍穿着 Lucan 的上衣。
Micah 为醉酒失态道歉，Lucan 表示不必。
两人谈到各自头痛，Lucan 用 dreamleaf 缓解。
Lucan 展示换用铝架的新义翅。
facts.anchor: “The frame is aluminum this time,” I explain

facts.fact: Micah 说可能不想还那件上衣，随即找补。
facts.anchor: “I might never want to give it back.”

facts.fact: Maple 紧跟 Micah， Lucan 观察这份依恋。
facts.anchor: like a gosling imprinting on its mother

facts.fact: Micah 用培根和正向强化教会 Maple 听令。
Maple 第二次试飞真正飞上天空。
成功后 Micah 拥抱 Lucan，两人相拥。
facts.anchor: He slams into me, wrapping his arms around my waist.
